assets.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: photorealistic solar appearance study for the current 50-module, gas-heating-retained Reitweg 25 proposal. Input image 1 is the exact original photograph to edit; image 2 is a supporting installation diagram only. Return just an edited photograph with the identical framing, scene and perspective of image 1. Add flush mounted thin black photovoltaic modules on the MAIN EAST roof only, following its 26-module diagram (upper RIGHT diagram). Each module landscape, real proportions 1.722m along ridge by 1.134m down slope, black frames and subtle cell texture. Crucial orientation: the diagram has north at LEFT, but the photo has north at RIGHT; map the diagram horizontally reversed, matching the roof windows. Diagram east arrangement in north-to-south columns numbered 1 through 11 and rows ridge-to-eaves numbered 1 through 6: row1 columns1,2,5,6,7,8,9,10 (8 panels); row2 columns1,2,5,6,7,8,9,10,11 (9); row3 columns1,2,5,10,11 (5); row4 none; row5 columns7,8 (2); row6 columns7,8 (2). Maintain clear tile borders around them and roof edges. Do not force schematic positions across an actual window: existing photograph architecture is immutable. Preserve the chimney, tiled roof geometry, ridge, eaves, vents, every tree and leaf occlusion, wooden facade, ground floor windows, grass, pool edge, planters, blue sky, existing sunlight and shadows. Change only roof panels. Do not add panels to any other roof or building. No labels, text, diagram graphics or watermark. This is a natural photographic edit, not a redesigned house.
assets.first_output_rejected_reason: Diagram orientation was not mirrored to photograph; wrong placement of compact and lower groups.

The failed edit image2 incorrectly put a 2-column group at LEFT and small lower group at RIGHT. Correct those locations: compact 2-column by3-row group belongs at FAR RIGHT north end, beyond/to right of the single highest skylight; broad upper array of about6 columns belongs LEFT OF that high skylight, mostly above the three central upper windows and left lower windows; its south extreme partly hidden by large tree on LEFT. assets.review: Corrected spatial grouping: broad array photo-left, compact two-column group photo-right beyond high skylight, lower group center-left partly behind tree. Ten roof windows retained, scene preserved. AI appearance rendering does not prove exact 26-module count or dimensionally reproduce each diagram position; broad band contains differently subdivided modules. Treat technical diagram and 3D layout as count authority.
